name: artic
description: Art Institute of Chicago collection. The CLI queries the museum's official public JSON API (api.artic.edu) for artworks, artists, exhibitions, events, articles, category terms and IIIF manifests, and adds the website's related-artworks lookup.

commands.name: search-artworks
commands.summary: Full-text search of the collection's artworks, with optional filters (public domain, on view, department, artist id), sort by date and pagination

params.name: q
params.description: Keyword query (title, artist, subject…)

params.name: public_domain
params.description: Only public-domain artworks (images free to reuse)

params.name: on_view
params.description: Only artworks currently on view in the galleries

params.name: department
params.description: Exact department title, e.g. 'Painting and Sculpture of Europe', 'Arts of the Americas', 'Prints and Drawings'

params.name: artist_id
params.description: Restrict to one artist. Use the numeric id from search-artists.

params.name: sort_date
params.description: Sort by start date instead of relevance

params.name: api_fields
params.description: Comma-separated fields to return (sent to the site as "fields"; clify's own --fields only shapes the output)

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Results per page (max 100) (sent to the site as "limit"; clify's own --limit only shapes the output)

params.name: page
params.description: Page number (1-based)

commands.name: facet-artworks
commands.summary: Get facet counts (aggregation buckets) over the whole artwork collection for a keyword field such as department, classification or artist

params.name: field
params.description: Keyword field to bucket on, e.g. department_title.keyword, artist_title.keyword, classification_title.keyword, artwork_type_title.keyword, place_of_origin.keyword, style_title.keyword

params.name: size
params.description: Number of buckets to return

commands.name: get-artwork
commands.summary: Get full details of one artwork by numeric id (title, artist, date, medium, dimensions, credit line, gallery, description, image id)

params.name: id
params.description: Artwork id, e.g. 111628 (Nighthawks)

params.name: api_fields
params.description: Optional comma-separated subset of fields to return (default: all) (sent to the site as "fields"; clify's own --fields only shapes the output)

notes: The www.artic.edu collection search page is behind a bot check, so these commands use the official public API at api.artic.edu (CC0 data, docs at https://api.artic.edu/docs/). It needs no auth and accepts at most 100 results per page.
Build image URLs from image_id: https://www.artic.edu/iiif/2/{image_id}/full/843,/0/default.jpg. Smaller widths such as 400, also work.
search-artworks filters use Elasticsearch bool/must terms. They combine with AND, and you can pass any subset. department must match the exact title, which you can get from facet-artworks.
Artwork, artist and exhibition ids are numeric. Website URLs follow https://www.artic.edu/artworks/{id}/{slug}; the slug is optional.
get-related-artworks returns an HTML fragment string. Artwork links inside it look like /artworks/{id}/{slug}; pass those ids to get-artwork.
For heavy use the museum asks clients to send an AIC-User-Agent header containing a contact email.

dropped.summary: Get the website's 'most similar' related artworks for an artwork (returned as an HTML fragment with artwork links)

params.name: id
params.description: Artwork id

dropped.verifyNote: The endpoint returns its data as an HTML fragment inside a JSON 'html' string. clify cannot run selectors on HTML embedded in JSON, so no structured fields can be extracted. search-artworks and get-artworks cover lookups.

dropped.summary: Get autocomplete title suggestions for a partial query, optionally limited to resource types (artworks, agents, exhibitions, ...)

params.name: q
params.description: Partial text matched against the start of titles, e.g. 'Water Lil'

params.name: resources
params.description: Optional comma-separated resource types to suggest from, e.g. artworks, agents, exhibitions, articles, events. Omit to search all types.
